# Learning Navigation in Unstructured Environments Using a Spatial Memory

**Authors:** Joni Pajarinen, Ville Kyrki  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** ICRA  
**DOI:** [10.1109/ICRA.2018.8460700](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICRA.2018.8460700)

## Abstract

We present a method for learning navigation in unstructured environments using a spatial memory.
